decisions.input: the snapshot embedded in cauldron.rzx (MD5 2f0ef98e5c59552663b15d5eb1175236; Q0, Dean 2026-10-26)
decisions.strategy: overlay: the game still draws the ULA; hooks in alt ROM image 1 (0x386E-) + page 26 at slot 6 put 2 x 2 4-bit sprites on every live XOR image (key = graphic, x, y, rows, width) - shown at a drawing plot's entry, hidden at an erasing plot's exit
decisions.figures: every image of the plotter 0x6357 (all 14 callers; Q1)
decisions.depth: sprites in front of everything (Q2); attribute painting kept (Q3)
decisions.colour: the image's first cell ink after the plotter paints it (Q4); black -> palette 8
decisions.other writers: ROM PR-ALL, CL-LINE, CL-SCROLL, the clear 0xB2A0, the tile writer 0xB366, the scrolls 0xDED2 / 0xDEEA: a touched live image loses its sprite and is tainted; a clear holding it whole forgets it (Q6)
decisions.interrupts: left on (the ROM IM 1 handler touches slots 0 and 2 only)
decisions.tail: 0x5E00 (0x5D52-0x5FB9 free in the whole RZX); printer buffer put back (the game reads 0x5B00 / 0x5B01)

verify.note: auto: the build input is the snapshot inside cauldron.rzx (Q0). Differential verify at every hook site (plotter entry incl. the body, PR-ALL, CL-LINE, CL-SCROLL, clear 0xB2A0, tile 0xB366, scrolls 0xDED2 / 0xDEEA): all registers, memory outside dead stack, interrupt safety (IY / I / alternates / SP floor / MMU7 / speed given back); after every event and at each plot's body start the sprite layer and the hooks' page-26 tables vs an independent model of the key table; each plot's screen change = its image; any screen write outside the plotter into a live key's rectangle fails; no patch-site or graphic write, no jump into a patched instruction, the original never runs in the hook range. + unit tests (overflow, full table, no free slot, wrap, too big, bad geometry, tainted / no-sprite keys, colour rule types 0-2 with INK / PAPER 9 and MASK-T, every touch site incl. the unreached CL-SCROLL, printer buffer, non-aligned cells) with 9 negative controls on their own code
